brief: A seven-cell honeycomb work surface, covered on top, with every open outside edge finished with caps.

requirements.evidence: 7 piece:full bases at (0,0,0) center plus 6 neighbors q/r: -1,0 / -1,1 / 0,-1 / 0,1 / 1,-1 / 1,0 forming hexagonal honeycomb cluster
7 top covers on every cell: cover:-1,0,0;full;top, cover:-1,1,0;full;top, cover:0,-1,0;full;top, cover:0,0,0;full;top, cover:0,1,0;full;top, cover:1,-1,0;full;top, cover:1,0,0;full;top

requirements.requirement: Every open outside edge finished with caps
requirements.evidence: 18 caps placed on all 18 perimeter edges: 3 caps per outer hex (e.g., cap:-1,0,0;*;90/150/210 etc.) covering entire outside perimeter; check_build meshClash clear

finish.summary: Built 7-cell honeycomb (center + 6 around), added full top covers to all 7 cells, and capped all 18 exposed outer edges; mesh check clear.
